title: Cuteee
body:
Overall very cute and good. 
The birbs are so adorable and will light up my day. Highly recommend this app :)

However, I would like to request some features (or maybe they already exist and I just didn’t know how to access):
1) Where can we input our mood tracker because for me I had to wait for the app to ask me input at certain time and sometimes they didn’t ask me. Also, it would be nice that I could add the mood back to the time I missed / forgot 
2) For the goals, it would be nice to be able to set the time period (like when does the goal starts + ends) because currently I can only have where it started

Anyway, this app is the best I’ve found and it kept me highly motivated. 

Thanksss <3
